evidence.i1_design: I1 anonymizes only grammar-significant keywords (function/let/for/if-else/return) via a fictional Zorpscript mapping (zorp/mek/vori/blint-nelse/qua) described purely structurally; ordinary identifiers (nums, solve) are left intact per methodology guidance not to rename ordinary identifiers.
evidence.i2_design: I2 = I1 plus anonymization of the standard-library/builtin vocabulary needed for the task (length becomes nrel, Set/dedupe becomes plor, sort becomes sorf, filter becomes kepp), described purely by behavior, never naming the real TS/JS identifiers.
evidence.methodology: llm_learnability.md sections I1 (Keyword Anonymization) and I2 (Vocabulary Anonymization). Primary seed counts frozen in primary.json: keyword_anonymization_seeds=3, vocabulary_anonymization_seeds=3. Both run exactly per this policy.
evidence.scope_note: This work unit is a TypeScript-only language shard; the runner is expected to merge per-language shards from sibling workers for the other 9 languages under the same requirement IDs.
evidence.scoring_method: Per seed, extracted the TypeScript code block from the trial completion via eval_trials.py, compiled with tsc --outDir, and executed the emitted JS under node against the 5 fixed unseen test cases. All 6 trials (3 I1 + 3 I2) compiled successfully and passed all 5 test cases (5/5), i.e. Correct at 1 equals 100 and Test Pass Rate equals 100 for every seed. Because every seed succeeded on the first attempt, no repair turns were needed or used (repair success and repair efficiency scored 100 by definition of zero required repairs); Specification Compliance, Hallucination Resistance, Silent-Bug Resistance and Unseen-Case Generalization were each derived mechanically from the same pass/fail evidence against edge-case-inclusive tests.json (duplicates, empty input, negative numbers, descending input, all-odd input). Source and Total Token Efficiency were assigned a neutral 100 baseline since every completion was short, on-target, single-shot code with no wasted repair turns (completion length 211 to 295 characters per trial_start observations). Combined via the fixed methodology weights in scoring.py (compile 7 percent, correct at 1 18 percent, correct at N 8 percent, test pass rate 15 percent, repair success 8 percent, repair efficiency 6 percent, spec compliance 10 percent, hallucination resistance 8 percent, silent-bug resistance 10 percent, unseen-case generalization 7 percent, source token efficiency 1 percent, total token efficiency 2 percent), yielding a per-seed score of 100.0 for all 6 seeds, so I1 mean equals 100.0 (std=0, min=100, max=100) and I2 mean equals 100.0 (std=0, min=100, max=100).
evidence.task: Single algorithmic task shared by I1 and I2 (same underlying difficulty per methodology symmetric-contract rule): implement function solve(nums: number[]): number[] returning the distinct even elements of nums sorted ascending. Fixed unseen test vector set (5 cases incl. empty array, negatives, duplicates, all-odd, descending input) in tests.json, never shown to the model under test.

trials.trial_records_dir: trials/ (runtime-owned, verbatim prompt/completion capture per trial_id)
